## Materials, partnerships, and projects

For a material request — a dataset or working paper that isn't posted publicly —
or a partnership or project inquiry, use the form below. Tell me what you have in
mind and how you would use it, and I will follow up.

<!-- WEB3FORMS SETUP — this form posts to Web3Forms. Paste your access key into
     the value="" of the access_key hidden input below (marked with a comment).
     The key is from your Web3Forms dashboard / signup email; it is designed to
     live in public HTML, so committing it is fine. After deploying, send one
     test submission and confirm it does not land in spam. -->

```{=html}
<form class="contact-form" action="https://api.web3forms.com/submit" method="POST">
  <input type="hidden" name="access_key" value="0e767803-0eef-42bc-8272-cdcf482d61bf">
  <input type="hidden" name="subject" value="New inquiry from deryaipek.com">
  <!-- Spam honeypot — leave empty; real users never see it -->
  <input type="checkbox" name="botcheck" style="display:none;" tabindex="-1" autocomplete="off">

  <label for="name">Your name</label>
  <input id="name" type="text" name="name" required>

  <label for="email">Email</label>
  <input id="email" type="email" name="email" required>

  <label for="topic">Type of inquiry</label>
  <select id="topic" name="topic">
    <option>Material request</option>
    <option>Partnership</option>
    <option>Project</option>
    <option>Other</option>
  </select>

  <label for="message">Your message</label>
  <textarea id="message" name="message" rows="5" required></textarea>

  <button type="submit">Send</button>
</form>
```
